messages.text:
"Main Character you can type any name in. And can choose male or female. Different styles of faces,hair and hair color, facial hair,scars,eyes, eyes colors.  First race is a tutorial of the controls and gameplay.  3 main boss drivers to win is Mandy-Lee(black hair with shocking blue eyes,  queen of the dark and scary), Zanrich the wild animal behavior driver(demi god of power and strength)and last the main boss \"Drikus the Insane\"demi god of insanity mixed joker look. 8 general underboss drivers. Ichi main underboss(anubis looks with Egyptian godlike vehicle). Chloe the white cerberus looking dog with mean looking vehicle. Jill the fast and majestic underboss. Timone the sheep and evil sheep vehicle.  Domino the sly fox with skillful vehicle,  Bubbles yhe goof with weird looking doggy car. Oscar the midnight black driver and black vehicle. Sussie the fat black driver with lots of speed boosts.Sky background of the game is apocalyptic weather(acid rain,thunderstorm, twister, hurricanes,floods,quicksand,clear sky,cloudy)with dangerous lighting and wind. Single player,open map quests(transport,taxi,single race,cup race, tournaments, escape gang and apocalyptic police,pvp). NPC are human, mutant, ghosts,ghouls, demons,demi gods (all playable characters as well).Their must be short(2-5 laps), medium(2-3 laps),long(1-2 laps). Game difficulties from easy to hard. 15 different types of terrain with apocalyptic genre(including sand dunes,mountains,desert,war zone,rain forest,dystopia, mines,beach, city,suburbs,jungle, ice tundra,volcanoes,). Focus on speed and smoothness of the graphics suited for most mobile games. Dark scary classical instrument music.  First must start the game while logging in to profile. Open the main menu. Start the game, continue the game, settings where you can adjust sound,video quality,  gore level of the game(blood/zombie green blood), terms and conditions, save/load game) and an exit the game. Menu must look with chains,blood, body parts and vehicles. You can change apocalyptic style vehicles that you acquire through missions, career and special events.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
